title: Service-contract cohort renewal forecast
prompt:
Forecast FY27 recurring service revenue from contract cohorts.

Begin with the July FY27 planning thread in `Requests/`, including the controller's follow-up after the first steering review. Use the current controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts, keeping earlier versions only for comparison. Resolve conflicts using dates, approvals, document status, and management correspondence. Reconcile posted Alder Ridge balances through the contractor-accounting MCP; keep external targets, peer data, bank terms, and market evidence tied to their controlling finance sources.

Model gross renewal, logo churn, partial downsell, contractual price escalation, expansion bookings, and start-month proration by cohort. Recognize retained and repriced opening-cohort ARR for all twelve FY27 months; recognize each signed expansion from its stated revenue start month through June 2027. Return `churn_and_downsell` as a positive ARR-loss amount. Do not apply renewal probability to already signed multiyear contracts. Reconcile the opening annualized recurring revenue to the accounting-system service-agreement population and calculate FY27 recurring revenue, ending ARR, and net revenue retention.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `opening_arr`, `gross_retained_arr`, `churn_and_downsell`, `price_escalation`, `expansion_arr`, `fy27_recurring_revenue`, `ending_arr`, `net_revenue_retention`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
